creative_direction: Create a weathered brick aqueduct with two broad arches. Use softened brick edges and a few pale mortar lines, keeping the arches clear and structurally calm. Ferns occupy the lower corners and do not climb into the sky. A narrow dry path passes through the opening. Leave the upper fifth as diffuse light and pale sky, without inscriptions or people. Use painterly architectural study. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
